item.title: Surrogation in Business Metrics: Why KPIs Can Derail Your Strategy
item.description: Surrogation happens when teams mistake KPIs for actual success. This post unpacks the psychology behind it, how metrics derail strategy, and what top-performing teams do to stay aligned. Learn how to measure what matters and avoid common KPI pitfalls.

item.title: Build a Metrics-Aware Culture That Transforms KPIs Into Impact
item.description: To build a truly data-driven business, it’s not just about KPIs—it’s about culture. Learn how mindset, communication, and empathy turn metrics into momentum, foster better decisions, and create a workplace where data drives progress, not pressure.

item.title: Why Your Growth Is Stuck: How to Design a Real Measurement System That Drives Results
item.description: Hitting a growth plateau despite solid performance? The problem isn’t execution—it’s measurement design. Learn how to build a connected system that links metrics, clarifies ownership, and turns lagging data into leading insights across Product-Led and Sales-Led motions.

item.title: Build a Sales-Led Growth System with the Pirate Metrics Wheel: Track What Actually Matters
item.description: The Sales-Led Pirate Metrics Wheel helps you identify blind spots, fix weak handoffs, and select 10–15 key metrics that align Marketing, Sales, Product, and Success. Stop tracking everything—start tracking what moves revenue. Use it as your diagnostic toolkit for scalable growth.

item.title: How to Use the Product-Led Pirate Metrics Wheel to Build a Smarter Growth System
item.description: Master product-led growth by turning vague questions into targeted investigations. Use the Pirate Metrics Wheel to identify drop-offs, assign ownership, and track only the metrics that matter. Build clarity, align teams, and drive smarter decisions with a powerful measurement system.

item.title: How to Build a Business Model Measurement System That Actually Drives Decisions
item.description: A strategy without measurement is just a guess. Learn how to design a business model scorecard that aligns metrics to your North Star, assigns ownership, and tracks success across ten key components—from value proposition to cost structure—with actionable insights and real targets.

item.title: How to Map Your Growth Funnel and Fix the Real Bottlenecks Slowing You Down
item.description: Healthy growth starts with visibility. Map your funnel using the AAARRR framework to find your weakest conversion point, fix broken handoffs, and run high-impact experiments. Stop guessing where growth breaks—start diagnosing and optimizing with the Pirate Canvas.

item.title: PATH Canvas: The Blueprint KPI Design System for Teams
item.description: PATH Canvas is a blueprint-based KPI design system that unifies teams through shared terminology, frameworks, and structured collaboration. It standardizes key components like North Star Metrics, Goals, and KPIs, enabling scalable, connected performance systems across organizations.

item.title: Difference Between Goals and Objectives Explained Clearly
item.description: Struggling with the difference between goals and objectives? Goals are high-level outcomes; objectives are measurable steps toward them. Master this distinction and learn how both fit into a full KPI system using the 5 Key Performance Drivers—North Star, Goals, Objectives, Activities, and KPIs.

item.title: Choosing the Right KPI Framework for Your Team
item.description: Most teams pick KPI frameworks by trend, not fit. This guide breaks down six proven frameworks—OKR Tree, Goal Tree, ROKS, 4DX, KPI Tree, Lean Analytics—and shows how to choose the right one based on challenge, timeline, and team size. No fluff—just the right tool for the job.
